goal_template:
On this page, fill in the application form with exactly these values:
{{field_lines}}
If a cookie or consent banner appears, close it first.
Leave the Approval code field empty. Do NOT click the Submit button. Do not navigate away from this page.
When every field is filled, stop and return JSON matching this exact structure:
{"filled": {"full_name": "...", "age": "...", "state": "...", "phone": "..."}, "submitted": false, "problems": []}
If a field cannot be filled, leave it and describe why in "problems".
submit_goal_template:
On this page, fill in the application form with exactly these values:
{{field_lines}}
- Approval code: "{{approval_code}}"
Then click the Submit button exactly once and wait for the confirmation page. Never click Submit a second time.
Return JSON matching this exact structure:
{"submitted": true, "confirmation_message": "...", "reference_number": "..."}
If no confirmation appears, return {"submitted": false, "problems": ["..."]}.
